sider_metadata.publication: Kuhn et al., Nucleic Acids Res. 2016, 44(D1):D1075-D1079

temporal_evaluation_critique.release_date_vs_evidence_date_distinctio: SIDER release date precedes 2018-12-31, but individual associations lack historical evidence timestamps.
temporal_evaluation_critique.three_quarter_sample_sufficiency: INSUFFICIENT for continuous longitudinal backtesting due to 4-5 year voids; SUFFICIENT only as architectural pipeline prototype.

decision_recommendation.recommendation: NO-GO for positive-unlabeled learning using uncurated SIDER 4.1
decision_recommendation.scientific_justification: SIDER 4.1 provides zero per-association evidence dates, covers only 13.9% of FAERS drugs, exhibits indication confounding (3,082 pairs), and multi-CID ambiguity. Constructing a positive set without dated evidence risks NLP noise and unverified evidence status.
decision_recommendation.proposed_smallest_methodological_revisio: Ingest structured FDA Drug Safety-related Labeling Changes (SrLC) database (2016-present) and Drugs@FDA original approval records to establish verified approval dates for a targeted high-reporting drug cohort.
